item.title: Audit and compliance fixes: Garante rows IT-I-01, IT-R-01, IT-R-02, IT-R-03 now cite the specific releases (not the press-room index); IT…
item.description: Audit and compliance fixes: Garante rows IT-I-01, IT-R-01, IT-R-02, IT-R-03 now cite the specific releases (not the press-room index); IT-R-02 corrected — the Garante set conditions on 12 Apr 2023 for lifting the ChatGPT limitation, service resumed 28 Apr 2023; FR-R-01 now cites the CNIL sanction decision (SAN-2022-019, via Légifrance) with LINC kept as an additional source; NL-R-01 now cites the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens decision page; EU-P-06, DE-P-01 and FR-P-01 now cite the specific guideline/strategy documents; EU-P-08 corrected to two new Art. 5 prohibitions (ba)–(bb) applicable from 2 Dec 2026. Template: dark-mode active-tab/country-button contrast fixed, general visible-focus rule added, EU-flag non-affiliation disclaimer added (footer and Method), Permissions-Policy meta tag removed (browsers ignore it; it has no meta equivalent). PRIVACY.md: personal-data sentence corrected. No counts changed.

item.title: Update 2026-11-23: all 8 backlog items resolved — Toeslagenaffaire (NL-I-02, NL-R-03), Irish DPC Grok training inquiry (IE-R-02), Spain A…
item.description: Update 2026-11-23: all 8 backlog items resolved — Toeslagenaffaire (NL-I-02, NL-R-03), Irish DPC Grok training inquiry (IE-R-02), Spain AI sandbox RD 817/2023 (ES-P-03), Germany KI-MIG now in force (DE-P-02), Italy LD 160/2026 and LD 179/2026 (IT-P-02, IT-P-03), Garante Character.AI fine (IT-R-04), Greek HDPA Clearview fine (GR-I-01, GR-R-01), and the Art. 50 marking duty covered by the new Art. 50 Guidelines (EU-P-09) and Transparency Code of Practice (EU-P-10) instead of a standalone row. Also added: Swedish IMY Clearview fine (SE-I-01, SE-R-01), Irish DPC Grok nudification inquiry (IE-R-03), Garante Replika €5m fine (IT-R-05), and national AI strategies for Finland, Estonia, Czechia, Austria, Portugal and Luxembourg (FI-P-01, EE-P-01, CZ-P-01, AT-P-01, PT-P-01, LU-P-01). Counts now 7 incidents, 16 responses, 29 instruments; 16 member states covered, 11 still without a verified row. Date note: the Transparency Code of Practice was published 10 June 2026 (IP/26/1328); 31 July 2026 was the signatory announcement (about 190 signatories).

item.description: Template, 2026-11-23: the map now also appears on the Policies tab (clicking a tile filters the policies list). The EU flag is no longer used; the non-affiliation statement is kept. Added a Back to top button and footer links, and a header link to AI Benar Advisory. Map tiles: accessible names now start with their visible text (code, name, number) for voice-control users, hover tooltips are hidden from screen readers (the label carries the same details), and empty-tile names meet 4.5:1 contrast.
